page.content:
Emperor Elrood IV was Emperor of the Known Universe (r. 1352–1428 AG), succeeding his uncle Saluso V as ruler of the Corrino Imperium. As Saluso's nephew, Elrood was a grandson of Emperor Mikael I.

page.overview:
Who is Elrood IV?

Emperor Elrood IV was Emperor of the Known Universe (r. 1352–1428 AG), succeeding his uncle Saluso V as ruler of the Corrino Imperium. As Saluso's nephew, Elrood was a grandson of Emperor Mikael I.

Elrood was succeeded in 1428 by his cousin Leto I.
